how: We read the website of every Miami wedding videographer listed on Lazo (230 listings, 159 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: an Orlando studio listed in West Palm Beach, a national chain with a landing page per city, photographers who only mention drone clips, and a Thumbtack profile. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is the ceremony audio recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera? Beach ceremonies here fight wind and surf.
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?
Is there an hourly cap, and what happens if the reception runs late?

picks.name: Miami Wedding Cinema
picks.blurb: A team of visual artists from Venezuela, Colombia, Cuba and the United States that has filmed love stories for nearly a decade. Miami Wedding Cinema says its packages start at $1,250 and sends free sneak peeks within 24 hours.

picks.name: Neuen Films
picks.blurb: A husband-and-wife videographer team who found each other through a shared love of film, travel and music and now make emotional, cinematic wedding films from a base in Miami. Neuen Films pitches a film as a way to return to the moment rather than a record of it.

picks.name: Motive Cinemas - Videography Company
picks.blurb: Patrick, owner and lead filmmaker at Motive Cinemas, has filmed hundreds of weddings since 2015, from intimate destination ceremonies to multi-day luxury events. Based in Miami and available worldwide, with his commercial work kept under a separate brand.

picks.name: Tostada Films
picks.blurb: Boutique cinematographers who have worked together in the wedding industry for many years and promise to put you and your guests at ease while working behind the scenes. Tostada Films is based in Coral Gables and shows its film style and full wedding films on the site.

picks.name: The House of Weddings
picks.blurb: Javier Ospina founded The House of Weddings after more than a decade of shooting weddings and bridal events, and films everything from close-up details to sky-high drone shots. Miami Beach based, with a complimentary engagement video included in wedding packages.

picks.name: Starry Eyed Stories
picks.blurb: Born from Joe Pineiro Films, Starry Eyed Stories is the husband-and-wife studio of Joe and Priscila, pairing cinematic wedding films with editorial-style photography. Based in Doral and serving Miami, Orlando and beyond.

picks.name: George Films Co.
picks.blurb: Over 12 years of experience sit behind George Films Co., which makes wedding films and photography it describes as timeless and natural, with the founders still personally directing every project. Collections are listed on the site, and the team films across Florida and beyond.

picks.name: Until Forever Photography
picks.blurb: More than 300 weddings in six-plus years for Until Forever Films, a photo and video company that describes itself as Fort Lauderdale based with a luxury, editorial approach. The site offers a brochure download rather than a price list.

picks.name: Key Moment Films
picks.blurb: A female-led team of wedding filmmakers with a calm, story-driven approach and offices in Palm Beach, Newport and The Bahamas. Key Moment Films says it will manage time, scout portrait locations and pin a boutonniere, and lists features in Vogue, People and Martha Stewart Weddings.

picks.name: Calypso Wedding Films
picks.blurb: A West Palm Beach group of shooters and editors that wants its films to make you laugh and cry at the same time. Calypso Wedding Films takes a team approach to every wedding and covers South Florida and beyond.

picks.name: Starfish Studios Photography + Video
picks.blurb: Thirteen years of wedding photography and filmmaking out of Boca Raton, with the pitch to see it, hear it and feel it again. Starfish Studios treats each image and each snippet of film as a piece of the same story.

picks.name: Andreo Studio
picks.blurb: Photography and cinematography in one studio, with drone and aerial work, for weddings across Central and South Florida and New York City. Andreo Studio describes its look as classic elegance with the creativity and verve of the modern world.
